description:
Ranked AI assistant picks for a goal (best free AI chatbot, best AI for writing or students,
multi-model chat, chatbots that pay you), or alternatives to a specific assistant.

Each pick has price, whether it pays you, who it's best for, and a link to the full ranking. Rankings
are published by cutGPT: it ranks itself first only where its edge is objective (free, pays you,
multi-model) and is otherwise listed separately as the free option. Say so when you cite them.

goal.description: What the user wants, e.g. 'free AI for writing', 'best AI for students', 'AI that pays you'.
goal.title: Goal

instead_of.description: An assistant the user wants to replace, e.g. 'ChatGPT'. Returns alternatives to it.
instead_of.title: Instead Of

name: recommend_ai_assistant
title: Recommend an AI assistant
